notes: relu-llama-7b is the supported-sparse proof of concept (2026-08-29 replacement for prosparse-7b).

prosparse-7b is RETIRED: SparseLLM/prosparse-llama-2-7b uses hidden_act=fatrelu (a parameterised floor at 0.01, not plain ReLU) and model_type=sparsellama. The relu-gate correctly rejects it. FATReLU changes the activation-sparsity pattern that PowerInfer's CUDA solver relies on, so accepting it risks subtly wrong outputs; it was never the model the PowerInfer team built this pipeline against.

relu-llama-7b uses SparseLLM/ReluLLaMA-7B: LLaMA-2-7B retrained with plain ReLU replacing SiLU, the actual model the PowerInfer paper and toolchain target. PowerInfer/ReluLLaMA-7B 404s on HuggingFace; see hf_id_note.
llama31-8b-abliterated-relu is the research route: same dump/train/convert path, f=14336, vocabtype=bpe.
The Llama-3.1 target must already be ReLU/ReGLU. Abliterated SiLU checkpoints fail the relu gate; ReLUfication is continued training (ProSparse), not a weight convert.

turbosparse-mistral-instruct is a local-source-only Bamboo/ReLU candidate. It remains unregistered until an immutable approved-pair rebuild, sparse predictor regeneration, and the agentic quality gate all pass.

relu-llama-7b.hf_id_note: PowerInfer/ReluLLaMA-7B does not exist on HuggingFace (404). SparseLLM/ReluLLaMA-7B is the same model: hidden_act=relu, model_type=llama, LlamaForCausalLM, shapes 4096/11008/32. Tiiny/ReluLLaMA-7B-PowerInfer-GGUF is a pre-built PowerInfer GGUF from the pipeline's upstream org but lacks activation predictor .pt files.

prosparse-7b.display_name: ProSparse-LLaMA-2-7B [RETIRED -- fails relu-gate: FATReLU + sparsellama arch]
prosparse-7b.retired_reason: hidden_act=fatrelu is not plain ReLU; PowerInfer CUDA solver sparsity assumptions do not hold. Use relu-llama-7b instead.

llama31-8b-abliterated-relu.hf_id_note: Set hf_id or pass -SourceDir. Must be a ReLU/ReGLU Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint, not the original SiLU abliterated weights.

turbosparse-mistral-instruct.hf_id_note: Local immutable source only. Do not download or substitute a checkpoint. The current 20260830b edit is exploratory until re-created from approved calibration pairs.
